title: How Sink Drainage Works: The Anatomy of a P-Trap
description: The P-trap is a critical component of every sink drainage system. Its primary engineering function is to hold a standing column of water that acts as a physical liquid seal, preventing noxious sewer gases and harmful bacteria from rising up through the sink fixture and entering the living space. As water flows down from the basin, it pushes through the trap and continues into the branch drain. When the water stops flowing, a specific amount remains trapped in the bottom curve due to the geometry of the fitting. Understanding how this hydraulic seal functions helps technicians maintain proper venting and prevent foul odors in residential buildings.
